t: The Smith & Locke 76mm gate bolt is a compact Brenton bolt designed for light-duty security on small gates, shed doors and access panels. Manufactured from strong steel with a galvanised finish, it offers reliable resistance to rust and harsh weather. Its small footprint makes it ideal for tight spaces and narrow frames, while the simple surface-mount design allows quick installation on timber or metal. Provides a straightforward locking solution for everyday use in outdoor or workshop environments.
